title: The structure of iterated Hopf Ore extensions
summary: This paper studies iterated Hopf Ore extensions (IHOEs) over a field $\Bbbk$ of characteristic zero, a significant class of connected Hopf algebras with finite Gelfand-Kirillov dimension. We establish two fundamental structural properties for arbitrary IHOEs of $\Bbbk$. First, the class of IHOEs of $\Bbbk$ is closed under Hopf subalgebras and quotient Hopf algebras. Second, every one-sided coideal subalgebra of an IHOE of $\Bbbk$ is an iterated Ore extension of $\Bbbk$.
